author: reek
body: Emits idiomatic PowerShell 7+ source from ShellScript values. Split into small functions to stay within LOWER deck budget.

author: reek
body: A function's parameters are declared inline and take neither a mandatory attribute nor a default, which is why they do not go through emit-ps-params.

author: reek
body: These name what the script MEANS rather than the cmdlet that happens to do it here, so a bash or ksh emitter renders its own spelling instead of inheriting PowerShell's.
